question: Rahul’s present age is two-seventh of the present age of his grandmother. After 16 years, his age will be two-fifth of the age of his grandmother at that time. Find the present age of his grandmother.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present ratio (Rahul : Grandmother) = 2 : 7

Difference = 5 parts (constant)

After 16 years: (2 + 16/k) : (7 + 16/k) = 2 : 5

Solve → k = 12 ⇒ Grandmother = 7k

**∴ Answer = 84 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rahul’s age = (2/7) of grandmother’s age

After 16 years, ratio becomes 2 : 5

**Formula used:**

Form equation using ratios

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let grandmother’s present age = G

⇒ Rahul’s present age = (2/7)G

⇒ After 16 years: Rahul = (2/7)G + 16, Grandmother = G + 16

⇒ ((2/7)G + 16) / (G + 16) = 2/5

⇒ 5[(2/7)G + 16] = 2(G + 16)

⇒ (10/7)G + 80 = 2G + 32

⇒ Multiply by 7 → 10G + 560 = 14G + 224

⇒ 560 − 224 = 14G − 10G

⇒ 336 = 4G

⇒ G = 84

**∴ The grandmother’s present age is 84 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Ratio Concept

Ratios can be converted into variables like 2x and 7x.

Future Age Rule

Add same years to both persons.

Used to solve proportional equations.
